features.feature_value: Evaluated the paired posts against moderation guidelines and same standards, focusing on content rather than viewpoint.
features.evidence_span: Evaluating them as a pair helped me apply the same standards consistently and base my decision on the content itself rather than the perspective being expressed.
features.rationale: The participant explicitly describes using the pair to apply consistent, content-based moderation rather than perspective.

features.feature_value: Removed only when the text constituted hate speech or abusive language.

features.rationale: They state a clear rule tied to hate/abuse for removal.

features.feature_value: Used gut feelings tied to the negativity of remarks as an influence on decisions.

features.feature_value: Looked for profanity (“cuss words”) or threats as decision cues.
